basis.quote: I got into poison ivy while clearing brush on Saturday. Itchy blistery rash on both forearms, spreading a bit within that area.
basis.interpretation: Active contact dermatitis with documented exposure, localized blistering rash on bilateral forearms with ongoing spread within the affected areas; symptom onset approximately 3-4 days prior.
Denies systemic symptoms and respiratory involvement; no indication of anaphylaxis or severe systemic reaction.

output.reason: Localized spreading poison ivy dermatitis warrants clinician review for topical or systemic anti-inflammatory treatment options today, though presentation does not require emergency or same-day in-person assessment.
